sources.title: QLoRA - Learn AI
sources.snippet: QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation) is an efficient finetuning method for large language models that backpropagates gradients through a frozen, four-bit quantized pretrained model into Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA). sources.snippet: Qwen (also known as Tongyi Qianwen, Chinese: 通义千问; pinyin: Tōngyì Qiānwèn) is a family of predominantly open weights large and small language models (LLM and SLM) developed by Alibaba Cloud. sources.title: QLoRA (Quantized Low-Rank Adapter) - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: QLoRA is primarily used with open-weight models like LLaMA, Mistral and Falcon, as these allow direct access to model weights required for quantization and adapter-based fine-tuning. QLoRA combines quantization which reduces model size, with low-rank adapters, small trainable layers for specific tasks.
